verdict: Packaging Corporation of America grew sales 12% to $2.6B as the acquired Greif mills contributed a full quarter — profit rose to $262M despite $13M of closure, fire and integration charges.

kpis.label: Corrugated shipments
kpis.note: per day vs a year ago

segments.name: Packaging
segments.note: Containerboard and corrugated boxes — the main business. Sales rose 13%, helped by the acquired Greif operations and better price and mix; segment operating income was $398M.

segments.name: Paper
segments.note: Uncoated freesheet paper (office and printing paper) — sales up 1% on better prices, with volume down 2.5%; segment operating income was $29M.

segments.name: Corporate and other
segments.note: Corporate and other sales that are not part of the two main segments.

opex.name: Selling, general and administrative
opex.note: Selling and back-office costs — $183M, up from $154M a year ago as the Greif operations were added.

opex.name: Other expense, net
opex.note: Other operating costs, net — $36M, including much of the quarter's special items (facility closures, a facility fire, and Wallula mill restructuring).

otherDetail: Net interest expense of $32M, partly offset by $1M of non-operating pension income — $31M net taken out of profit.

takeaways.title: Growth came from Greif — and price
takeaways.text: Sales rose 12% to $2.6B. Corrugated shipments rose 10.6% including Greif, while legacy shipments slipped 0.5%; favorable price and mix in Packaging added $0.79 a share vs a year ago.

takeaways.title: Packaging did the heavy lifting
takeaways.text: Packaging segment operating income rose to $398M from $328M a year ago ($408M excluding special items). Paper earned $29M, down from $36M.

takeaways.title: Profit ex-charges was higher
takeaways.text: Reported EPS of $2.93 includes $0.11 of special items. Excluding them, EPS was $3.04 and net income $272M — the number to compare with a normal quarter.

oneTimers: Special items totaled $13M before tax ($10M after tax, $0.11 per share): $6M of facility closure costs, $3M of acquisition and integration costs, $3M for a fire at a corrugated products facility, and $0.3M of Wallula mill restructuring charges. Excluding them, net income was $272M ($3.04 per share).
